page_title: LEN 1-1 REN | Lens v Rennes 20/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+4' The goalkeeper pulls off a remarkable reflex save to deny a rebound from Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes)! That was a huge opportunity!

90+4' Nemanja Matic (Rennes) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Brice Samba, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
90+4' Jeremy Doku (Rennes) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
90+2' Nemanja Matic (Rennes) attempts to find Guela Doue, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Lens.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' Here is a change. Florian Sotoca is going off and Franck Haise gives the last tactical orders to Oscar Cortes (Lens).
89' Benjamin Bourigeaud comes off the pitch to be replaced by Guela Doue (Rennes).
88' The corner from David Costa (Lens) is cleared away by the defence.

87' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Facundo Medina (Lens) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Lens win a corner kick.
86' Lens can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

85' Stijn Spierings (Lens) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lens will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
85' David Costa (Lens) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
85' The resulting set piece from Lens is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lens.
84' A cross into the box from Florian Sotoca (Lens) is cleared.
82' A substitution has been made. Jeanuel Belocian is replaced by Adrien Truffert (Rennes).
81' Franck Haise has decided to substitute Andy Diouf and he is replaced by Stijn Spierings (Lens).
79' The game is interrupted. Jonathan Gradit (Lens) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.

75' A neat pass is well received by Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible diving save to block his shot.
75' Substitution. Angelo Fulgini leaves the pitch and is replaced by David Costa (Lens).
75' Franck Haise prepares a substitution. Deiver Machado is replaced by Massadio Haidara (Lens).
74' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Adrien Thomasson as he is replaced by Morgan Guilavogui (Lens).
74' Jeremy Doku (Rennes) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
72' Some great play by Andy Diouf (Lens) ends with a shot on the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal, but Steve Mandanda sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.

71' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
70' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Benoit Millot blows for a foul.
69' Florian Sotoca (Lens) jinks his way past two defenders and from the edge of the box has an effort which goes just wide of the left post.
67' The resulting corner from Angelo Fulgini (Lens) comes to nothing.
66' The corner from Angelo Fulgini (Lens) is hurriedly cleared. Lens force their opponents to concede a corner.
66' Andy Diouf (Lens) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Lens have been awarded a corner kick.
65' Unlucky! Andy Diouf (Lens) hits a thunderous volley on the edge of the box that just flies just wide of the left post.
63' Bruno Genesio decides to make a substitution. Ludovic Blas will be replaced by Jeremy Doku (Rennes).
63' Bruno Genesio has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Desire Doue (Rennes) replacing Enzo Le Fee.
62' Here's the change. Baptiste Santamaria leaves the pitch and Nemanja Matic (Rennes) comes on as a substitute.

59' What an opportunity! Florian Sotoca (Lens) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
58' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Lorenz Assignon (Rennes). Benoit Millot saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Lens in a dangerous position.
57' Warmed Omari (Rennes) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Millot had an easy-decision to make.
56' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) takes the free kick and curls the ball just over the crossbar. That was close!
55' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) commits a rough foul. Benoit Millot stops the game and makes a call. Lens win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
55' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
54' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away. Good work from Lens as they win a corner.
53' 1 - 1 Goal! Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Brice Samba into the bottom right corner.
53' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
52' Referee Benoit Millot is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Rennes!
52' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Rennes, he's going to review using VAR.
51' The referee gives a yellow card to Salis Abdul Samed (Lens).
51' Referee Benoit Millot sees the trip by Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. PENALTY to Rennes! Let's see who will take responsibility.
48' Fine play by Amine Gouiri (Rennes) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles over the bar.
47' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Steve Mandanda.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' Benoit Millot blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Great chance! Angelo Fulgini (Lens) picks up a rebound inside the box, cuts inside his marker but rifles his shot high over the bar.
45+1' Florian Sotoca (Lens) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Florian Sotoca (Lens) heads on.
44' Deiver Machado (Lens) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Benoit Millot who sees an offensive foul.
40' Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
38' Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
38' Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) brings his opponent down. Benoit Millot has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
36' The game is interrupted now, Angelo Fulgini (Lens) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
34' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
33' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
33' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Andy Diouf (Lens) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
31' Lens take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
28' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Brice Samba intercepts the ball.
24' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens).
22' Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
19' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Rennes will take a throw-in.
17' Rennes are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
13' Benoit Millot interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes).
12' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
12' Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lens.
9' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) takes a short run up and tries to place the ball from the free kick, but the defensive wall blocks the effort.
8' A clumsy foul by Warmed Omari (Rennes) and Benoit Millot blows his whistle. Lens are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
7' Facundo Medina (Lens) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
6' Dangerous play by Ludovic Blas (Rennes). Benoit Millot blows his whistle for a foul.

3' 1 - 0 Deiver Machado (Lens) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight into the bottom right corner. He couldn't have done it any better. 1:0.
3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lens comes to nothing.
3' The corner is swung in but Lens can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Lens are awarded a corner kick.

3' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball is out of play and Lens manage to earn a corner.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Rennes will have the kick-off.
Benoit Millot is the one to supervise the game today.
